phase: EXPLORE: consumed Development diagnostic, not fresh confirmation
question: Does background-aligned local late contrast exceed a scaled and shifted empirical foreground-tail envelope?
eligibility: Retain all16 zones and previous pure-reference eligibility; late window centered on first2s background dominant peak only, complete windows disjoint from near bins; no mixture/return selection.
method: N=sum positive near bins; C=mean center3 minus mean flanks2. Envelope U=max C(shift(F))/N(shift(F)) over every foreground training frame and zero-padded shift. Clamp U>=0. Residual score=(C(y)-N(y)*U)/max(1,N(y)/median training foreground N). Foreground block2 sets late cutoff=max(0,max scores)+3*1.4826*MAD(scores), floored at1e-9. Background blocks0,1,2 set near cutoff=max N+3*1.4826*MAD(N). Late requires score>cutoff and C>0; near requires N>near cutoff. Dual requires both.
controls: Foreground block3 is held out from this diagnostic fitting/calibration, but is already consumed data. Background block3 and all return are controls. Full return is a late-positive and dual-negative control. Scalar UNKNOWN never filters evaluation frames.
limits: One already-consumed capture; no independent event count or calibrated false-positive rate.
Fixed integer shifts and amplitude scaling do not cover all optical, pose, tremor or reflectance changes.
Report near amplitude extrapolation outside foreground training/calibration min-max.
Local contrast is not metric depth, target count, optical cause or alert evidence.
Foreground almost fills RGB but ToF occupancy is not calibrated.
stop: One fixed offline score run; no shift/bin/threshold sweep or successor; preserve previous NNLS and fingerprint negatives. Mechanical bugs may be repaired with retained receipts. No hardware/firmware changes.
